question: How many hours of video are uploaded to YouTube every single hour?
source_title: Hours of video uploaded to YouTube every minute (Statista)
explainer: More than 500 hours of video are uploaded every minute, so about 30,000 hours of new video arrive every hour.

question: How many Google searches happen every second?
source_title: Google now sees more than 5 trillion searches per year (Search Engine Land)
explainer: Google handles about 14 billion searches a day, which is about 160,000 every second.

question: How many iPhones stacked flat on top of each other would reach the top of the Empire State Building?
explainer: The Empire State Building is 443 m to its tip and an iPhone 15 is 7.8 mm thick: about 57,000 phones.

question: How many emails are sent every second worldwide?
explainer: About 361.6 billion emails were sent and received a day in 2024, which is about 4.2 million a second.

question: At the average American's daily phone use, how many whole years between the ages of 15 and 80 are spent on the phone?
source_title: Study finds the average American spent 2.5 months on their phone in 2024 (Reviews.org)
explainer: Five hours is 5/24 of a day. Over 65 years that adds up to about 14 years spent looking at a screen.

question: Reading one English Wikipedia article a minute without stopping, how many years would it take to read them all?
explainer: English Wikipedia passed 7 million articles in 2025. At one a minute that is 7 million minutes, about 13 years with no sleep.

question: How many photos are taken worldwide every second?
explainer: About 1.94 trillion photos were taken in 2024, almost all on phones. Divided by 31.6 million seconds that is about 61,000 photos a second.

question: How many 1.44 MB floppy disks would it take to hold what a 128 GB phone stores?
explainer: 128 GB is 128,000 MB. Divided by 1.44 MB a disk that is about 89,000 floppies, a stack about 300 m tall.

question: How many times could the world's undersea internet cables wrap around the Earth?
explainer: There are about 1.4 million km of submarine cable in service. The equator is 40,075 km, so about 35 times around.

question: How many smartphones are sold worldwide every second?
explainer: About 1.24 billion smartphones shipped in 2024. Divided by 31.6 million seconds, that is about 39 phones a second.

question: How many Amazon packages are delivered in the United States every minute?
source_title: Amazon tops UPS and FedEx in US deliveries (Fortune)
explainer: Amazon delivered about 5.9 billion packages in the US in 2023. A year has 525,960 minutes, so about 11,000 packages a minute.

question: How many times does the average American check their phone in a year?
explainer: A 2024 survey found Americans check their phones about 205 times a day. Over a year that is about 75,000 glances.

question: How many years would it take to watch all the video uploaded to YouTube in a single day?
source_title: Hours of video uploaded to YouTube every minute (Statista)
explainer: 500 hours a minute times 1,440 minutes is 720,000 hours of video a day. Watching 24/7, that is about 82 years, a whole lifetime for one day's uploads.

question: How many iPhones could Apple have bought with its own 2024 revenue?
source_title: Apple reports fourth quarter results (Apple Newsroom)
explainer: Apple's revenue for fiscal 2024 was $391 billion. At $799 an iPhone 16 that is about 490 million phones.

question: How many WhatsApp messages are sent every second?
explainer: WhatsApp carries about 100 billion messages a day. Divided by 86,400 seconds, that is about 1.2 million messages a second.

question: How many Google searches does the average person on Earth make a day?
source_title: Google now sees more than 5 trillion searches per year (Search Engine Land)
explainer: About 14 billion searches a day divided by 8.1 billion people is about 1.7 searches each, every day.

question: Typing non-stop at an ordinary pace, how many years would it take to retype all of English Wikipedia?
explainer: English Wikipedia holds about 4.6 billion words. At 40 words a minute that is 115 million minutes, about 220 years of typing.

question: If all the smartphones shipped in 2024 were laid end to end, how many times would they wrap around the equator?
explainer: 1.24 billion phones about 15 cm long is 186,000 km. The equator is 40,075 km, so about 4.6 times around.

question: How many full days a year does the average American spend looking at their phone?
source_title: Study finds the average American spent 2.5 months on their phone in 2024 (Reviews.org)
explainer: About five hours a day on the phone is 1,826 hours a year, which is about 76 full days.

question: How many 128 GB phones would it take to store everything the Internet Archive keeps?
source_title: Internet Archive storage update 2024 (Library of Congress DSA slides)
explainer: The Internet Archive held about 175 petabytes of unique data in 2024. Divided by 128 GB that is about 1.4 million phones.

question: How many Google searches happen during a 90-minute football match?
source_title: Google now sees more than 5 trillion searches per year (Search Engine Land)
explainer: About 160,000 searches a second times 5,400 seconds is about 870 million searches during the match.

question: How many PlayStation home consoles have been sold for every person in Japan?
source_title: PlayStation consoles have sold over 500 million units (VGChartz)
explainer: About 500 million PlayStation home consoles have been sold since 1994, and Japan has about 124 million people: four consoles each.

question: How many emails are sent worldwide during a three-minute pop song?
explainer: About 4.2 million emails a second times 180 seconds is about 750 million emails per song.
